    Nonidentity path factors in the Figure 55 walk #

    The alternating efficiency argument in BGRS 8.4 produces categorical factorizations through earlier tackle components. Figure 55 then chooses nonidentity irreducible paths presenting those factors and uses them in the interlacement induction. This file proves that the forced factors cannot be invertible and packages positive-length path presentations of them.
